title: Yummy Uruguayan Beef Stew
description: A hearty, sweet and savory beef stew with dark brown sugar and aromatic herbs, perfect for post-workout recovery. The rich braise is packed with protein and comforting flavors.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Add the beef cubes and brown them on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Reduce heat to medium and add the sliced onion, minced garlic, and carrot, cooking until the onion turns translucent, about 7 minutes.
Stir in the canned diced tomatoes, beef broth, dark brown sugar, soy sauce, paprika, cumin, and bay leaves, mixing well.
Bring the mixture to a gentle boil, then cover and reduce the heat to low so it simmers slowly.
Let the stew cook uncovered for 90 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the beef is tender and the sauce thickens.
Remove the bay leaves and season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Let the stew rest for 10 minutes before serving, allowing flavors to meld.
Ladle the stew into bowls and garnish with fresh parsley if desired.
Serve hot with crusty bread or over boiled potatoes for a comforting meal.
